Lower Text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon attacks your opponent's Digimon, this Digimon may unsuspend.
Upper Text: ＜Vortex＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.)
[When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. If this effect suspended your Digimon, this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon until the end of their turn.
